result.title: Like Slack… But for AI bots.
result.description:
Jack Dorsey’s company, Block, recently launched Buzz. It's basically a Slack workspace but for AI agents, and it's currently free, decentralized and open-source.

Here's how it works:
👋 It starts you off with a core team: Fizz (the builder), Honey (the writer), and Bumble (the researcher).
💻 You can give them parallel tasks and watch them build it in real time using any model you choose.
✍️ You can even tag them in a thread to peer-review each other's code and offer constructive feedback.
🔒 Because it's built on the open-source Nostr protocol, it's model-agnostic, decentralized, and entirely under your control.

This kind of alternative is great for developers, startups, and anyone looking to run a self-sovereign AI workforce under their own control.

Would this replace Slack for you?

result.title: How To Skip The Kimi K3 Waitlist
result.description:
Here's how to access the secret AI model everyone is trying to get their hands on 👀

Kimi K3 is apparently so powerful that they had to pause new subscriptions because of the massive surge in demand. But you don’t have to sit on the waitlist with everyone else. 

Here's a backdoor workaround to access the single-agent version of Kimi K3 right now:

1️⃣ Go to platform.kimi.ai (their developer platform) and create an account.
2️⃣ Head to the billing section and add a small credit (even $1 works).
3️⃣ Open the AI Playground and select "Kimi K3" from the model selector.
4️⃣ Adjust your settings: Crank the context window up toward the 1-million-token limit and increase the reasoning effort.
5️⃣ Start prompting directly in the Playground like a regular chatbot.

That's it. You're now using one of the most capable models available while everyone else is stuck in line.
